text:
Claire Li: PartnerCloud asked for a compatibility-first marketplace reference: small Terraform module + example app + region/arch mapping + publish notes. Want something they can vet in one afternoon.
Elena (PartnerCloud PM): Thanks! Key asks: minimal footprint, multi-arch notes (arm64/x86), clear provider pinning, and a cert checklist for our compliance team.
Ravi Patel: Proposal: single module `marketplace_shim` + examples/mini-app that shows listing + startup. Keep <200 LOC HCL and a 1-page ONBOARDING.md.
Diego Morales: I'll author variables.tf to expose: name, image, region, arch (arm|x86), enable_kms (bool). Local map for instance types.
Maya Chen: Add COMPLIANCE.md with the KMS example and an audit-log sink placeholder. Make KMS opt-in (default false).
Ravi Patel: CI: lightweight GH Action that runs terraform fmt -> tflint -> terraform init/plan -> terraform apply (smoke) -> run container and curl /health -> terraform destroy. Use small ephemeral workspace.
Diego Morales: Example main.tf snippet: 
```
# modules/marketplace_shim/main.tf
terraform { required_providers { partner = { source = "partnercloud/partner" version = ">= 1.0, < 2.0" } } }
variable "arch" { type = string default = "x86" }
locals { instance_by_arch = { arm = "c7g.small" x86 = "c6i.small" } }
resource "partner_market_listing" "this" { name = var.name image = var.image instance_type = local.instance_by_arch[var.arch] region = var.region }
resource "partner_kms_key" "maybe" { count = var.enable_kms ? 1 : 0 purpose = "ENCRYPTION" }
output "listing_id" { value = partner_market_listing.this.id }
```
Elena (PartnerCloud PM): Please include a short table of supported regions and recommended SKU per arch. We need to flag any SKUs with specialized drivers.
Maya Chen: Will add a table in README.md and a WARNING section: "Do not use GPUs that require host-level driver install" and list example SKUs to avoid.
Claire Li: Add a tiny Dockerized FastAPI example under examples/fastapi with /health and /invoke (invoke returns a fake model_output). Keep app ~30-50 LOC.
Diego Morales: Dockerfile snippet: 
```
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
COPY app.py ./
CMD ["uvicorn", "app:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8080"]
```
Ravi Patel: Docs: add ONBOARDING.md with steps: fork -> pin providers -> run smoke CI -> create release tag -> notify Redwood for verification. Also add versioning guidance.
partner-bot: Checklist: https://redwood-internal/partner-checklists/marketplace-compat (auto-post)
Maya Chen: Add .tflint.hcl and commit terraform.lock.hcl. In CI run `terraform fmt -check` and `tflint`. Make the CI fail loudly on lint.
Elena (PartnerCloud PM): This looks great. Can you include a short sample vars.tfvars for CI and a quick note on how to test arm images locally (qemu or cloud runner)?
Diego Morales: Will include sample vars and a short note: use cloud build runners for arm smoke tests or qemu-user-static in CI container, but note slow performance.
Claire Li: Owners: Diego -> PR + initial module, Ravi -> module review, Maya -> security docs. We'll post PR link here and schedule 30m pairing if partner wants walkthrough.
Ravi Patel: One more: include LICENSE (Apache-2.0) and a brief CONTRIBUTING.md for partners.
Claire Li: Thanks team. Diego, tag us when PR is ready. Keep examples tiny and dependency-free.
Diego Morales: Roger, aiming to open the PR today.
